acceptanceCriteria.statement: defineFeedbackEpisode binds exact grounded finding input pins (ref+digest match), computes episodeId as sha256 over canonical content, rejects authority fields smuggled at any depth (principal, authority, disposition, verdict, etc.), requires MEASURED impact to have finite numeric measurements with all inputs GROUNDED and consumption CURRENT, and exact replay of the same content converges with no second mutation (CONVERGED).
evidenceRequired: Lifecycle suite output on current main.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: respond allows only legal transitions (OPEN->any disposition, RESPONDED_DEFERRED->any, RESPONDED_ACTED->DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED; RESOLVED/OUTCOME_RECORDED/RESPONDED_REJECTED/RESPONDED_SUPERSEDED accept none), verifies the principal as an explicit argument through the injected authority (rejecting OBSERVER/EVALUATOR/PROVIDER/OPTIMIZER kinds), enforces per-disposition field rules (ACTED requires non-empty actionRefs + frozen outcome policy; REJECTED requires rationaleRef; DEFERRED requires revisitCondition; SUPERSEDED requires successorEpisodeRef), and every transition is a CAS on the expected head revision with idempotent replay and crash-recovery (put-then-CAS leaving exactly one transition).
evidenceRequired: Lifecycle suite output on current main.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: recordOutcome uses only the frozen policy digest stored in the current ACTED response (never a later policy), yields UNKNOWN (never advancing the head) for unresolved fresh input, reused inputs/attempts, non-strictly-later boundaries, or missing/null required measurements (never coercing missing values to zero), classifies IMPROVED/REGRESSED/NO_CHANGE by signed delta against minEffect/noChangeBand with the direction factor; resolve derives the terminal FeedbackResolution from head state (measured resolutions carry an outcomeRef, REJECTED_ACKNOWLEDGED/SUPERSEDED carry none), rejects caller-supplied values that differ from the derived value, and RESOLVED is terminal.
evidenceRequired: Lifecycle suite output on current main.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: An episode/response carrying principal/authority/disposition fields inside finding, impact, observation or provider payloads is rejected; a call with an OBSERVER/EVALUATOR/PROVIDER/OPTIMIZER principal, or a principal the injected authority does not verify, fails the respond/resolve transition.

Recording an outcome against a non-current response, reusing an episode input as fresh evidence, reusing a baseline execution attempt, or relying on a fresh boundary not strictly after the latest baseline boundary yields UNKNOWN with explicit reasons (e.g. NON_CURRENT_RESPONSE, ATTEMPT_REUSED, BOUNDARY_NOT_AFTER_RESPONSE) and leaves the head at RESPONDED_ACTED; resolving from an UNKNOWN outcome or a DEFERRED state fails.
